definitions.full: H7325. rur [ רִיר ] verb flow (like slime); — (Aramaic רִירָא saliva, spittle ; compare Arabic slaver slobber ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular אֶתזֿוֺבוֺ בְּשָׂרוֺ רָר Lev 15:3 his flesh ( בָּשָׂר 3 ) flows with his issue .
